The '''chief executive''' of [[MarTech Corporation]] during [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstiuted Sith Empire]] was involved in a price-fixing scheme, and was subsequently blackmailed when a [[Datapad/Legends|datapad]] was recovered with a holorecording implicating the executive in the crime.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Diplomacy|Paying the Price}}</ref>
